author: Polar_Express
body:
Folks,

If you have a moment please look over this map I would like to submit it for consideration. I call it the Minefield Campaign ( the field has land mines ). Please test it out and let me know what you think. It has a tower theme, a few portals to make it easy to get around, and multiple ways to get to the monuments.

Pics: http://imgur.com/a/mvICH

DL:  https://www.dropbox.com/s/xhk93pveuuon71f/Minefielddl.zip?dl=0


Thanks again!
